dataset: UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset (GED) Global version 26.1
owner: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP), Uppsala University
attribution: UCDP GED 26.1; Davies, Pettersson & Öberg (2026); Sundberg & Melander (2013)
promotion_requirements: Acquire the official UCDP GED 26.1 CSV ZIP and record the acquired source SHA-256.
Use a closed historical observation period ending no later than 2025-12-31.
Aggregate raw events into coarse grid cells; never publish raw event coordinates through this conflict snapshot layer.
Suppress cells below the minimum event threshold.
Do not project actor names, source headlines, operational routes or event-level tactical detail.
Review generated feature count, byte size, temporal coverage and not-live boundary before manifest activation.
